changelog_v2: Adds the M15_v2 (2011-2026) timeframe entry with populated regime segments; adds a dataset_identity_resolution rule for M15 vs M15_v2 (previously absent -- v1 only had M15-current); adds a data_file_sha256 integrity field to every entry, gated as described in fail_closed_default; adds an irreplaceable_segment_flag on H1 and M15_v2 for 2006-2011.

fail_closed_default.rule: A timeframe entry is loadable ONLY if its top-level "status" field is exactly "VALIDATED". Every other value (AWAITING_REGIME_MAP, AWAITING_DATA_FILE_HASH, AWAITING_REGIME_MAP_AND_DATA_FILE_HASH, or any value not listed here) means the loader MUST treat 100% of that timeframe's bars as SEALED -- zero bars readable as discovery, zero bars usable for parameterization or testing. A missing, pending, or partially-populated status is never to be treated as "open" or "discovery by default".
fail_closed_default.reason: The documented failure mode is a loader reading an un-partitioned timeframe as entirely discovery and silently burning the sealed half. Fail-closed makes that failure mode structurally impossible: an unfinished config blocks access instead of granting it.
fail_closed_default.exception_for_already_operating_entries: M15 (current) is already live in production (already read correctly by the loader per Data Acquisition's confirmation). Its status stays VALIDATED even though its data_file_sha256 is still PENDING_FORMAL_VERIFICATION below -- downgrading an already-operating, already-confirmed entry was not requested and would disrupt working access for a purely-additive integrity check. The three timeframes below that are NOT yet live (M15_v2, M5, H1) are held to the full standard: VALIDATED requires BOTH regime segments populated AND data_file_sha256 confirmed. There is no operational cost to being maximally strict on integrations that are not yet live.

dataset_identity_resolution.problem: M15 (current, 2022-2026, single-cutoff method) and M15_v2 (2011-2026, stratified method) overlap completely over M15's entire span. A generic request for 'M15' is ambiguous between them.
dataset_identity_resolution.rule_1_no_implicit_default: "M15" and "M15_v2" are distinct, explicit keys. There is no alias, no default, and no fallback between them. A loader or consumer request that does not specify one of these two exact keys MUST fail with an ambiguous-identifier error and grant zero access. Ambiguity is a hard error, never silently resolved -- this is the same fail-closed principle applied to identifiers instead of to status.
dataset_identity_resolution.rule_2_overlap_inheritance_not_arbitrati: For the calendar range where M15_v2 overlaps M15's own dataset span ([M15.dataset.start_epoch, M15.dataset.end_epoch] = [1671187500, 1783922400]), M15_v2 does NOT independently compute or apply its own stratified split. It INHERITS M15's existing discovery_range/embargo_range/sealed_range verbatim for that exact range. This is not an arbitration rule (e.g. 'whichever is more restrictive wins') -- an arbitration rule was considered and rejected, because applying M15_v2's own stratified method to that range independently would produce a different (and, worked example showed, earlier/more conservative) boundary than M15's already-ratified cutoff, and enforcing whichever is 'more restrictive' would retroactively reclassify data that DC-0003/DC-0004/S18 already treated as open discovery -- exactly the disruption CEO's instruction to leave M15 untouched was meant to prevent. Inheritance (M15_v2 simply defers to M15's ruling for the shared range, computing nothing of its own there) avoids this entirely: the two entries are consistent by construction, not by comparison.
dataset_identity_resolution.rule_3_each_entry_owns_only_its_non_over: M15_v2's OWN regime-segment split (see its regime_segments below) governs only: (a) the prefix 2011-07-26 to 2022-12-16T10:45:00Z (before M15's own data begins), and (b) the tail 2026-07-13T06:00:00Z to 2026-07-27T00:00:00Z (after M15's own data ends, since M15_v2's dataset extends 14 days further than M15's).

data_file_integrity.description: content_hash (bottom of this file) protects the integrity of this manifest's own text. It does NOT verify that the manifest's claims about a given data file (n_bars, date range) actually match the real file on disk -- a swapped data file would not be caught by content_hash alone. Each timeframe entry below therefore also carries data_file_sha256: the SHA-256 of the actual market-data file it governs. A loader MUST verify both: (1) this manifest's own content_hash, and (2) each data file's data_file_sha256 against the file it is about to read. A mismatch on EITHER check is fail-closed for that entry (and, for a manifest-level mismatch, for the whole file).
data_file_integrity.sourcing_requirement: Every data_file_sha256 value below MUST be sourced directly from a document or commit formally published by Data Acquisition -- never copied secondhand from a CEO message or any other relayed report, per the same source-verification discipline applied to every other fact in this manifest. Three values were relayed to Statistician secondhand this round (via CEO, who had them from Data Acquisition's report) and are DELIBERATELY NOT used below for that reason. See formal_requests_to_data_acquisition.

same_window_resampled_predicate.description: A test on timeframe B is NOT an independent confirmation of a hypothesis whose parameters were fixed using timeframe A data if the two calendar windows overlap, regardless of which resolution is finer, and regardless of which half of any timeframe's own discovery/sealed split the overlapping portion falls into.

inputs.parameterization_window: {start_epoch, end_epoch} -- the calendar range of data (at any timeframe) that informed the hypothesis's frozen parameters
inputs.test_window: {start_epoch, end_epoch, timeframe} -- the calendar range and resolution of the data proposed as a confirmation test

same_window_resampled_predicate.formula: overlap_seconds = max(0, min(parameterization_window.end_epoch, test_window.end_epoch) - max(parameterization_window.start_epoch, test_window.start_epoch))
same_window_resampled_predicate.action_if_true: Label the result SAME-WINDOW-RESAMPLED. Never report it as an independent, out-of-sample, or cross-resolution confirmation.
same_window_resampled_predicate.action_if_false: Eligible to be reported as an independent confirmation, subject to every other applicable rule (borrowed-parameter provenance, family-wise correction, etc.).

margin_factor.note: The single safety-margin factor used consistently across every embargo derivation below (960->1000 M15 bars; 2880->3000 M5 bars; 240->250 H1 bars). Applied, not re-chosen, at each resolution.

M15_v2.regime_map_provenance: Segment boundaries below use the four-bucket regime characterization from Research Lab's FOUR_REGIME_RUN_STATUS_v1.0.md (2011-2015 bear -42%, 2015-2020 bull +86%, 2020-2022 correction -17%, 2022-2026 bull +223%), operationalized into exact instants via a disclosed convention: each year-label transition = that calendar year's January 1st, 00:00:00Z. This is a convention applied to an already-existing characterization, not a fresh day-precision mechanical run -- flagged in formal_requests_to_data_acquisition for confirmation/refinement in a future version. Sufficient for this version's functional purpose (real, disclosed, non-arbitrary boundaries enabling fail-closed enforcement), not a claim of day-level statistical precision.

irreplaceable_segment_flag.note: The single most irreplaceable segment in the lab's history: never observed at any resolution, in this lab, ever -- not even by the withdrawn M15-extended attempt. Superseded reference point: M15_v2's actual delivered start (2011-07-26) replaces the earlier withdrawn attempt's target date (2011-07-25). This field exists so a consumer reading ONLY this JSON (not the prose protocol documents) still sees the heightened-vigilance flag. Its irreplaceability is a reason for MORE caution before opening it, not less -- it does not change the split_ratio or embargo width, which remain the standard 50/50 and 250-bar rules once a regime map is delivered.
